description: Na₄Mo(NO)₂ is Aluminum carbonitride-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaN₄O square pyramids, corners with four equivalent NaN₂O₂ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent MoN₂O₂ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.42 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four N and one O atom to form distorted NaN₄O square pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaN₄O square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one MoN₂O₂ tetrahedra, corners with five NaO₄ tetrahedra, edges with five NaN₄O square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaN₂O₂ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MoN₂O₂ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.68 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.48 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four N and one O atom to form distorted NaN₄O square pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaN₄O square pyramids, corners with three NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent MoN₂O₂ tetrahedra, edges with five NaN₄O square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one MoN₂O₂ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaN₂O₂ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.54 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.78 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to two N and two O atoms to form distorted NaN₂O₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaN₄O square pyramids, corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent MoN₂O₂ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaN₄O square pyramids. There is one shorter (2.42 Å) and one longer (2.43 Å) Na-N bond length. There is one shorter (2.35 Å) and one longer (2.40 Å) Na-O bond length. Mo is bonded to two N and two O atoms to form MoN₂O₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaN₄O square pyramids, corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaN₄O square pyramids. Both Mo-N bond lengths are 1.82 Å. There is one shorter (1.90 Å) and one longer (1.91 Å) Mo-O bond length. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded to five Na and one Mo atom to form distorted NNa₅Mo octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NNa₅Mo octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₅Mo octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Mo tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent ONa₅Mo octahedra, and edges with six NNa₅Mo octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-34°. In the second N site, N is bonded to five Na and one Mo atom to form distorted NNa₅Mo octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NNa₅Mo octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Mo tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent ONa₅Mo octahedra, and edges with six NNa₅Mo octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-34°. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Mo atom to form distorted ONa₅Mo octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NNa₅Mo octahedra, corners with six equivalent ONa₃Mo tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₅Mo octahedra, and edges with five NNa₅Mo octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-14°. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form ONa₃Mo tetrahedra that share corners with four NNa₅Mo octahedra, corners with six equivalent ONa₅Mo octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Mo tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 55-69°.
